title: Membership&Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal
description:
Membership&Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal

Starting Date: ASAP

Contract type: Full-time and open-ended

Salary : R$146,581 commensurate with relevant experience and skills

About the Job

Better Cotton Initiative (BCI) is the world’s largest cotton sustainability initiative – we support more sustainable farming practices and farm livelihoods for nearly 3 million farmers in the Better Cotton network in 23 countries around the world. BCI works across all farm sizes and geographies. It is crucial that Better Cotton producers, and the cotton they produce, can continue to access international markets in the face of changing regulatory and business expectations. Are you purpose-led and ready to embark on a journey to shape the future of sustainable cotton? Join us at Better Cotton as Membership& Supply ChainOfficer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

The Challenge

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improving soil health across our network, improving farm income and supporting women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

As Membership & Supply Chain Officer, you will be responsible for supporting members and supply chain actors to achieve their Better Cotton sourcing targets by enabling access to the Better Cotton Platform, delivering insights through reporting, and supporting stakeholder engagement processes, training and events, which contribute to systemic change towards more sustainable cotton production. You will provide high quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal Team, and support reporting for the region.

Areas that play to your strengths

We are seeking a motivated Membership & Supply Chain Officer to join our Membership and Supply Chain Team.

Membership Engagement & Support
  • Recruit and onboard new members and suppliers.
  • Guide applicants through documentation, cotton consumption calculations, and compliance steps.
  • Maintain member accounts and process applications using Salesforce and assist members with annual cotton consumption reporting.
  • Respond to stakeholder queries via Helpdesk and escalate when needed.
  • Support external communications and awareness of Better Cotton initiatives.
Supply Chain Operations
  • Monitor and troubleshoot account creation and transaction processes.
  • Clean and validate data to ensure system accuracy and compliance.
  • Compile and analyze KPIs (e.g., uptake rates, inventory structures).
  • Deliver supplier training programs (online and in-person).
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve tools and processes.
Reporting & Administration
  • Provide high-quality administrative support to the LATAM/Portugal team.
  • Support regional reporting and performance monitoring.
  • Translate and adapt tools and documents for cultural and linguistic relevance.
We are looking for someone who has
  • Customer service orientation – for account creation, data validation, and stakeholder management.
  • Data analysis and reporting – Excel advanced functions.
  • Event and training organization and delivery – for organizing and delivering online and in-person training programs and stakeholder events.
  • Documentation and compliance review – for onboarding and membership processing.
  • Helpdesk systems and procedures – for managing stakeholder queries.
  • Sustainability and textile industry knowledge – understanding Better Cotton’s mission and practices.
  • Multilingual communication – ideally Spanish, Portuguese, and English.
  • Effective communication
  • Collaboration and adaptability
  • Problem-solving and attention to detail
  • Time management
  • Power BI or similar tool
  • Chain of Custody and Traceability
  • Initiative and ownership
What we offer
  • Remote work and flexible working arrangements
  • The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
  • Continuous learning and development
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Insurance
  • Meal Voucher Allowance
  • 13 th Salary (Bonus) – Paid in 2 instalments Nov/Dec (Additional)
  • Legal protections of Local Labour Law
  • All other Better Cotton Global Policies apply (including enhancements)
  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus 8-9 Bank Holidays and a further 3 discretionary days off over Christmas/year end period.
  • A warm, positive working environment where everyone is valued
  • The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.
Working arrangements

The position is full-time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply now

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1-page maximum) by or before via this link.

In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human-led assessment experience.

Our hiring process

Initial Screening:

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews:

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.

Assessment and Testing:

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.

Reference Checks:

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.

About Better Cotton

Better Cotton is a global not-for-profit organization supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.

About our Values

The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:

  • Trustworthy (including honest, transparent, credible)
  • As having Integrity (including responsible, authentic)
  • Positive (including problem-solving, pragmatic)
  • Engaging (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
  • Daring (including courageous, innovative, game-changing)

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.

We have a zero-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Descrição

Join to apply for the Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS role at Triunfo Logística

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para envio de notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para manter os veículos em boas condições e garantir a segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco com base nas atividades das equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer a inspeção de segurança diariamente, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para atender à fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunir as CATs, analisar levantamento de acidentes, calcular horas perdidas e enviar cópias ao Gerente de Filial e à empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e das horas perdidas;
  • Notificar, através de comunicado em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido com simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente;
  • Preencher no site do INSS uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão, local, hora, agente causador, situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador e enviando através do site do INSS;
  • Coordenar a troca ou recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para a Triunfo estar preparada em caso de incêndio;
  • Promover a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, com treinamento total, apresentação via Power Point, palestras em sala de reuniões e apresentando-os aos Supervisores;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno com informações preventivas e atualidades.
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades para assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS;
  • Planejar e executar ações para conformidade com requisitos de áreas específicas, como o Porto de Itaguaí, para fins de conformidade.
  • Representar a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações;
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar ao Setor de Recursos Humanos;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para assuntos de saúde e higiene, através de reuniões e palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, acompanhar atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, patrimônio e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, seguindo padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.

title: Engineering Manager - MLOps & Analytics
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - MLOps & Analytics role at Canonical

1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - MLOps & Analytics role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team's processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience in the Linux and open-source software world
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project -- even if that is community open source contributions.
  • Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
O objetivo é encontrar um profissional de social media que possua habilidades tanto em design quanto em redação. Interagir com a comunidade online, respondendo mensagens e comentários de forma empática, clara e dentro da voz da marca.


Colaborar com outras áreas (como marketing, performance, design e atendimento) para garantir integração e consistência nas entregas.


Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de redes sociais, comportamento do público e novas ferramentas de criação e análise.


Qualificações


Experiência prévia em gestão de redes sociais e criação de conteúdo (portfólio será considerado um diferencial).


Domínio de ferramentas de design gráfico, como Photoshop ou Figma.


Excelente escrita e criatividade, com capacidade de adaptar o tom de voz a diferentes plataformas e públicos.


Noções de fotografia, vídeo e edição básica, para criação de conteúdos ágeis e originais.


Conhecimento das principais métricas de engajamento, alcance e conversão em plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn e Facebook.


Capacidade de organização e autogestão, com atenção a prazos e detalhes.


Perfil colaborativo, proatividade e interesse genuíno em criar conteúdo relevante e de impacto.

title: .NET UI Developer with Blazor Hybrid
description:
Hey, Dev, check the opportunity we have here at Brick Abode!


About Brick Abode


We are a software development company that serves clients from multiple countries around the world, with differing technological needs. Therefore, we value a good computer science base.


Contractors with a solid understanding of the basic building blocks of today’s technology are really welcome and thrive at Brick Abode.


People here are given autonomy, not put into a box to work only on one thing. They are in touch with the business needs of our clients, sometimes communicating with them directly.


We challenge ourselves to learn new things and go outside our comfort zone. Candidates who are up to the challenge will have an amazing career with us.


If you feel that your values fit with Brick Abode culture, check below for further details about this Position.


What kind of professional are we looking for?


We’re looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can navigate between technology and business contexts with ease, feel comfortable in fast-paced environments, and have great communication skills.

Our team is Brazil and USA-based, and communication is in English. The position is fully remote.



What do I need to have to apply for this position?


  • ASP.NET
  • .NET Core 9
  • Rich UI development in Blazor
  • Proven experience with Web development and the use of REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of Blazor Hybrid (WinForms Blazor)
  • Working knowledge of MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) for better code separation and maintainability
  • Working knowledge of Secure applications using OAuth, JWT, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


#Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar parcerias com fornecedores e consultorias especializadas, implementando novas ferramentas e metodologias que garantam eficiência nos processos de seleção de candidatos externos e assegurem a entrega de serviços de qualidade, alinhados às necessidades da empresa;
  • Fazer a gestão da equipe de Atração e Seleção, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo das competências técnicas e comportamentais por meio de feedbacks estruturados, acompanhamento individualizado e estímulo à inovação. O objetivo é fortalecer a performance, aumentar o engajamento e fomentar um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e de alto desempenho;
  • Acompanhar o orçamento da área, assegurando a alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros e a otimização dos investimentos;
  • Gerir programas de entrada , como Jovem Aprendiz, Estágio e Trainee, assegurando o desenvolvimento sustentável de novos talentos alinhados à cultura e às metas da organização mantendo a conformidade com as legislações específicas de estágio e aprendizagem;

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas;

  • Experiência em RH com ênfase em Atração e Seleção;

  • Experiência em Diversidade, equidade e inclusão;


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Venture Analyst
description:
About Flow Capital

Flow Capital Corp. is a publicly listed provider of flexible growth and alternative capital solutions dedicated to supporting market-leading, high-growth companies. Since 2018, we’ve helped businesses in the US, UK, and Canada access financing that drives growth while minimizing dilution and retaining founder control. Our focus is on revenue-generating, VC-backed, and founder-owned companies seeking growth capital. Learn more at 



Overview


We’re looking for an entry-level analyst to join our venture team at Flow Capital. This role sits between our Marketing and Originations teams, starting with a focus on marketing. You’ll support a wide range of activities, including identifying and researching potential investment opportunities and supporting business development, while also contributing to marketing campaigns, content creation, and brand initiatives.

This is an excellent entry point for someone interested in gaining exposure to the venture ecosystem.


  • Location: Remote. Candidates must be available to work North American Eastern Time (GMT-4).
  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Proof of fluency will be required.
  • Please submit your resume in English only.



Responsibilities

  • Conduct research to identify potential investment and partner opportunities.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis (e.g., market sizing, competitive analysis, web analytics data).
  • Support lead generation and outbound email campaign setup, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with marketing to create content, marketing materials and assist with digital initiatives as needed.
  • Track and analyze performance, providing insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Participate in events, webinars, and other initiatives to build Flow Capital’s brand.
  • Manage and update CRM records.



Qualifications

  • Business or a related field degree from a strong academic program.
  • A passion for early stage investing and a desire to be in the Venture Ecosystem.
  • Entry-level role. 0–2 years of experience in venture, business development, or finance preferred, but not required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills.
  • Curious, proactive, eager to learn and take on new challenges. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proactive, versatile, and comfortable handling a variety of tasks across marketing functions
  • Familiarity with tools including AI tools, Webflow, HubSpot, Canva, outreach tools (e.g., Reply.io), PitchBook, SEMrush, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Google Analytics.



Why Join Flow Capital?  

  • Be part of a leading Canadian venture debt firm working with high-growth companies.
  • Gain exposure to venture capital, finance, and growth-stage tech ecosystems.
  • Join a small, collaborative team where your work has a direct impact.



Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. Thank you for your interest.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

O estúdio Geiko Games, criador de títulos adultos de sucesso com milhões de downloads, está em fase de expansão e busca um(a) Assistente de Produção apaixonado(a) e com alto potencial para trabalhar diretamente com o Diretor Criativo e absorver conhecimento específico da área. Esta não é uma vaga comum; é uma oportunidade de mentoria direta e formação intensiva, trabalhando lado a lado com o responsável no desenvolvimento de nossas propriedades intelectuais.


A vaga oferece grande potencial de crescimento. Nosso objetivo é treinar alguém que internalize a visão e os processos para que possa ocupar cargo de gerência no futuro.


O que você fará:


  • Colaborar em todas as fases da produção dos jogos, do rascunho ao marketing, em um processo de adaptação mentorado.
  • Aprender a operar softwares de ponta da indústria (renderização 3D, edição de imagem, etc.) em um ambiente de produção ágil, com feedback e iteração em busca da excelência.
  • Receberá feedback direto e tarefas apontadas pelo diretor, com foco na execução com excelência da visão criativa.


O Perfil que Buscamos (Necessário):


  • Hardware: Setup pessoal (PC/Notebook) capaz de rodar softwares gráficos de alta demanda (Placa de vídeo com 4GB+, 6GB preferível).
  • Flexibilidade e Vontade de Crescer: Capacidade de transitar por diversas áreas do conhecimento, com foco na visão e na qualidade, com interesse de crescer na empresa.
  • Coachability (Capacidade de ser Treinado(a)): Uma fome genuína por aprendizado e uma postura altamente receptiva a feedback direto e construtivo. Buscamos alguém que veja a crítica como uma ferramenta natural do processo de crescimento e adaptação.
  • Experiência: Nenhuma experiência profissional prévia em game dev é necessária. Valorizamos o potencial e a vontade de ser moldado(a) por um processo de mentoria de alto nível de uma área de trabalho específica e rara no Brasil.


Diferenciais:


  • Inglês (leitura/escrita) para pesquisa e comunicação.
  • Intimidade com o ecossistema de PCs, softwares e jogos indie.
  • Paixão demonstrável por storytelling, jogos narrativos e cultura pop.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / .NET / SQL)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, .NET, and SQL to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce.


Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, .NET/C#
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • CI/CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, learn and grow together!
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with kind, smart, and creative people
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • 8 US holidays, PTO can be used for your local holiday
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Software Engineer - Frontend II
description:

An established and rapidly growing Ads organization is seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to join the Campaign Management team. This team is focused on expanding and improving the core functionality that enables advertisers to create, edit, share, and analyze their ad campaigns with ease.

You’ll be working on key advertiser-facing tools, helping design and build experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and impactful. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute not just to new products, but also to the internal platform used by other product teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Work on the Ads platform UI , particularly features related to campaign creation and management
  • Contribute to and maintain the Ads Design System used across multiple teams
  • Build intuitive interfaces for advertisers to efficiently manage their campaigns
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend engineers to define and deliver user-centric features
  • Take ownership of projects end-to-end — from technical design to launch and support
  • Participate in code reviews and continuously advocate for high-quality code and design standards
  • Help shape the evolution of the Ads experience from the frontend perspective


Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python
  • Frameworks & Libraries: React, React Query, Thrift, Kafka
  • Datastores: Postgres, Cassandra, Druid, Redis, BigQuery
  • Tools: Storybook, Playwright


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Frontend Engineering , especially with modern React
  • Ability to own features or projects from design to deployment
  • Comfortable with ambiguous problems , proposing clear and scalable solutions

Bonus if you have experience with:

  • Building modern, intuitive UIs and maintaining design systems

O negócio é complementado por plataformas líderes de comércio eletrônico, como Ray-Ban.com, EyeBuyDirect, Clearly e muito mais.


Tenha a oportunidade de crescer conosco e projetar sua carreira profissional. Conheça a EssilorLuxottica e faça parte da nossa comunidade internacional. Você consegue enxergar o seu #FutureInSight?


Se interessou? Veja a descrição das atividades e inscreva-se:


Responsabilidades e Principais Atividades:

  • Serviços: Conferência das notas fiscais de serviço e suas retenções. Conciliação do relatório das notas de entradas de serviço e contas a pagar para garantir a correta aplicação das retenções destes impostos nos serviços prestados e tomados.
  • Retenções na Fonte: Execução da rotina fiscal na apuração dos impostos retidos na fonte, incluindo ISS, IRRF, CSRF e INSS, nas operações de serviços prestados e tomados.
  • Obrigações Acessórias – Serviços: Elaboração, validação e envio das obrigações acessórias, como declarações de ISS dos municípios correspondentes às operações, DCTFweb e REINF. Preparação das guias de recolhimento de ISS, IRRF, CSRF e INSS para o fluxo de pagamento.
  • Suporte Fiscal – Serviços: Apoio às empresas do grupo em questões fiscais do dia a dia e setup de sistema que impacta operações de serviços. Emissão de CND Municipal e Federal, acompanhamento da legislação, suporte às áreas de negócios no esclarecimento de dúvidas fiscais, atendimento à Auditoria externa e interna, e apoio na fiscalização Federal.
  • Conciliação Contábil: Conciliação contábil das contas de ISS, IRRF, CSRF e INSS. Participação em projetos que envolvam a área fiscal.
  • Tributos Estaduais: Execução da rotina fiscal na apuração de ICMS e IPI de diversos estados. Conferência dos livros fiscais de entradas e saídas, Livro Apuração e CIAP. Cálculo de Diferencial de alíquota, ICMS antecipado, ICMS-ST e FECP. Validação das regras fiscais das operações, como CFOP, CST, base e alíquota destes impostos.
  • Obrigações Acessórias – Tributos Estaduais: Elaboração, validação e envio de obrigações acessórias como Sped Fiscal (EFD ICMS/IPI), GIA, GIA-ST, DAPI, DECLAN, DIME e demais obrigações conforme legislação de cada Estado. Preparação das guias de recolhimento para o fluxo de pagamento.
  • Suporte Fiscal – Tributos Estaduais: Apoio às empresas do grupo nas questões fiscais do dia a dia e setup de sistema que impacta as operações de entradas e saídas.
  • Legislação e Auditoria: Acompanhamento da legislação, suporte às áreas de negócios no esclarecimento de dúvidas fiscais e monitoramento das caixas postais estaduais. Atendimento à Auditoria externa e interna, apoio no atendimento à fiscalização e participação em projetos que envolvem a área fiscal.
  • Conciliação Contábil – Tributos Estaduais: Conciliação contábil das contas de ICMS e IPI.

Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Formação: Nível superior completo.
  • Experiência em rotinas fiscais.

Conhecimentos Específicos / Habilidades:

  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel.
  • Desejável experiência em sistemas: Oracle, SAP, Mastersaf e Syncro.
  • Características desejadas: Dinamismo, iniciativa, organização, pró-atividade, comunicação, persistência, atenção aos detalhes, trabalho sob pressão e trabalho em equipe.

title: Arquiteto de dados (AWS)
description:
Para ser uma Pessoa Arquiteta de Soluções de Dados na A3 buscamos alguém para:

O profissional será responsável por conduzir assessments técnicos e de negócio, identificando oportunidades de melhoria, propondo arquiteturas otimizadas e garantindo a adoção de melhores práticas na nuvem AWS.

Assessment & Discovery:

Conduzir entrevistas técnicas e de negócio com stakeholders para entender desafios, requisitos e oportunidades.

Realizar brainstorming sessions para alinhar soluções de dados com objetivos estratégicos.

Avaliar ambientes existentes (on-premises ou cloud), identificando gaps técnicos e de governança.

Definir modelos de dados, pipelines de ETL/ELT e estratégias de integração.

Liderança Técnica:

Atuar como ponte entre times técnicos e de negócio, traduzindo demandas em soluções viáveis.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-ready machine learning systems and end-to-end pipelines on AWS.
  • Partner with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to define requirements, select algorithms, and deliver impactful ML solutions.
  • Architect, optimize, and maintain ML infrastructure — including data ingestion, model training, deployment, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management — using AWS services.
  • Lead the data preparation and feature engineering process, ensuring data quality, integrity, and scalability across large datasets.
  • Implement and optimize ML models (supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems) with a focus on performance, accuracy, and reliability.
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines and orchestration workflows to support ML systems at scale.
  • Integrate models into backend services and APIs, ensuring seamless interaction with applications and end users.
  • Contribute to MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model registries, experiment tracking, automated retraining, and infrastructure-as-code provisioning.
  • Utilize Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation to build and maintain scalable, secure ML infrastructure.
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI/ML, evaluating new research, frameworks, and tools to enhance product capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding best practices throughout the ML lifecycle.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of professional experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS for ML workflows (data pipelines, model training, deployment, and monitoring).
  • Expert proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript for building ML-integrated backend services and automation workflows.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation ) for deploying ML infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of data processing and analysis tools (Pandas, NumPy, SQL) and orchestration workflows.
  • Proven track record deploying ML systems into production and integrating them into real products or services at scale.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and MLOps best practices.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, or agentic AI systems.
  • Expertise in deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Amazon SageMaker for model lifecycle management.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or publications in the field.
  • Understanding of data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, and real-time data processing


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

title: SAP Release Manager
description:
Role: SAP Release Manager

Location: LATAM Region (Remote)

Duration: 06+ Months Contract


An SAP Release Manager plans, coordinates, and controls the entire SAP release lifecycle, from defining release strategies and schedules to managing deployments and post-go-live support, ensuring quality, minimizing business disruption, and maintaining compliance with standards like ITIL and SOX. Key responsibilities include stakeholder communication, risk management, process governance, and continuous improvement of the release process through post-release reviews and key performance indicator (KPI) tracking.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Planning: Develop and maintain the SAP release strategy, plan, and calendar, coordinating release windows and cycles across various SAP modules and integrated applications.
  • Execution & Coordination: Manage and coordinate all release activities, ensuring timely and seamless execution by working closely with development, testing, and infrastructure teams.
  • Governance & Compliance: Implement and enforce release management processes and quality gates, ensuring adherence to standards such as ITIL, SOX, and audit requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks to the release schedule, quality, and scope, and develop mitigation strategies to prevent delays or disruptions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Liaise with business stakeholders, project managers, and other relevant teams to align release activities with business priorities.
  • Communication: Act as the central point of communication, providing transparency on release plans, risks, impacts, and progress to all involved parties.
  • Post-Release Activities: Conduct post-release reviews and postmortems, track release KPIs (success rate, defect leakage), and identify lessons learned for continuous process improvement.
  • Quality Assurance: Oversee the entire release lifecycle, ensuring that all release criteria, including functionality, performance, and security requirements, are met before deployment.
  • Process Improvement: Drive initiatives to improve workflows and efficiency, developing and implementing automation tools and frameworks to streamline release processes.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

Como Analista de Implantação Protheus RH você será responsável por realizar implantação, sustentação e parametrização dos módulos de Recursos Humanos do ERP TOTVS Protheus.   • Propor melhorias e padronizações nos processos de gestão de pessoas via Protheus;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e funcional das implantações;
  • Apoiar a integração entre módulos de RH e outros ambientes TOTVS.


Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de Tecnologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou correlatas;
  • Experiência na implantação ou sustentação do Protheus RH;
  • Domínio dos módulos: Folha, Ponto, eSocial, Medicina e Segurança, Avaliação, Pesquisa de Desempenho, APP RH e Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Conhecimento em rotinas legais e obrigações acessórias (eSocial, DIRF, RAIS, CAGED, etc.);
  • Vivência em parametrizações, fórmulas, tabelas e eventos do Protheus;
  • Capacidade de analisar e propor soluções funcionais aderentes ao negócio,
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido.


Requisitos desejáveis

SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:


  • Experiência com integrações Fluig–Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em ADVPL (para acompanhamento técnico de customizações),
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação ou atualização de versão (UPDDISTR).

  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile nativos para iOS e Android, utilizando Flutter;
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis , baseadas em boas práticas como Clean Architecture, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Trabalhar na definição e implementação de Design Systems , garantindo interfaces modernas, acessíveis e consistentes;
  • Implementar e gerenciar o estado da aplicação (ex: BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, MobX);
  • Integrar com APIs RESTful , gerenciar estados (loading, error) e realizar persistência local (Hive, Isar, Drift ou SQLite);
  • Assegurar a qualidade e performance do código , conduzindo code reviews e promovendo boas práticas;
  • Colaborar com os times de Web, Backend, Produto e Design para garantir soluções integradas e de alto impacto;
  • Estabelecer e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD e automação de builds (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Codemagic, etc.);
  • Realizar testes unitários, de integração e UI para garantir estabilidade e alta performance;
  • Ser referência técnica no time mobile, apoiando e orientando outros desenvolvedores.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proficiência comprovada em Flutter/Dart.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida de aplicativos mobile (iOS e Android) e dos processos de build e deploy (App Store e Google Play).
  • Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de software , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de código.
  • Experiência em injeção de dependência (DI) e inversão de controle (IoC).
  • Integração com APIs RESTful e manipulação de dados (JSON).
  • Habilidade com testes unitários e de integração.
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git e fluxo Git Flow.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, comunicação clara e colaboração com stakeholders.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com testes de UI e automação.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (Sentry, Firebase Performance, Crashlytics).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin/Swift) e comunicação via Platform Channels.
  • Publicação e manutenção de aplicativos nas lojas oficiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e automação de builds.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ

  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Tech Lead Flutter e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na posição.

title: Chief Executive Officer
description:
Hartmann Young is proud to be partnered with a leading dietary supplement manufacturer serving both domestic and international markets across South America. The company is recognised for its strong scientific foundation, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and commitment to innovation in nutritional products. With a diversified customer base spanning consumer health, functional foods, and nutraceutical brands, the business is poised for a new phase of strategic growth and international expansion.


As Chief Executive Officer , you will lead the company’s strategic, operational, and commercial direction across South America. You will be responsible for driving profitability, operational excellence, and long-term growth, ensuring the business continues to innovate and compete at the forefront of the dietary supplement manufacturing industry.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the company’s strategic vision and long-term business objectives across Brazil, Chile, Argentina, and other key South American markets.
  • Oversee all business operations, including manufacturing, R&D, sales, quality, and regulatory functions.
  • Lead organisational transformation to enhance efficiency, scalability, and market responsiveness.
  • Drive revenue growth through new partnerships, customer acquisition, and product innovation.
  • Ensure operational excellence, quality assurance, and compliance with international standards (GMP, ISO, ANVISA, etc.).
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across all departments.
  • Represent the company in strategic alliances, investor relations, and regional industry events.
  • Work closely with the board and investors to deliver sustainable financial and market performance.


Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred).
  • 15+ years of leadership experience in dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, or pharmaceutical manufacturing .
  • Proven track record in executive management, business transformation, or scaling operations across Latin America.
  • Deep understanding of supplement manufacturing processes, regulatory frameworks, and supply chain dynamics.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen with experience leading P&L responsibility.
  • Bilingual or multilingual (Portuguese, Spanish, and English proficiency highly desirable).
  • Dynamic leadership style with a focus on innovation, growth, and organizational excellence.

title: M365 Consultant
description:
English-speaking Microsoft 365 Consultant


$3,500 – $5,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

About the Company

Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP delivering enterprise-grade Microsoft 365, Azure, and multi-cloud solutions to global clients.

Their teams help organizations secure, optimize, and modernize their Microsoft ecosystems — improving collaboration, compliance, and operational efficiency across M365, Azure, and hybrid environments.


You’ll be part of a specialist Microsoft 365 Center of Excellence, working alongside senior engineers and consultants who design, implement, and manage advanced enterprise environments.

This is a long-term remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class Microsoft ecosystem — with exposure to architecture, automation, governance, and continuous service improvement.


The Role

As a Microsoft 365 Consultant, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of operational, architectural, administrative, and consultative responsibilities across enterprise M365 environments.

This is a hands-on engineering and advisory position — blending technical depth with strategic consulting. You’ll work directly with enterprise clients to keep their Microsoft 365 ecosystems secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You’ll work on:


  • Leading monthly environment reviews and recommending strategic improvements
  • (Secure Score, license optimization, usage insights, product roadmap updates)
  • Designing and maintaining Microsoft 365 architectures aligned with Microsoft best practices
  • Configuring and deploying M365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, etc.)
  • Monitoring service health, telemetry, and usage to proactively resolve issues
  • Performing incident, request, and change management activities
  • Contributing to documentation including configuration designs and operational procedures
  • Collaborating in change control, adoption, and stabilization meetings
  • Coordinating with Microsoft Support when escalations are required


This is not a traditional support role — you’ll engage directly with customers, provide insights on modernization, and shape the future of their Microsoft 365 environments.


What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years’ experience in Microsoft 365 administration, engineering, or consulting
  • Hands-on expertise in Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance, and security best practices in M365
  • Experience managing and optimizing Microsoft licensing, consumption, and usage reporting
  • Familiarity with PowerShell scripting, automation, and M365 monitoring tools
  • Ability to conduct environmental health checks and present improvement recommendations
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

title: Data Engineer_ Snowflake
description:
Job Description: Senior Snowflake Data Engineer (Migration & Modelling)

Location: Brazil/ Costa Rica (Remote)

Job Type: Contract / Project-Based (Staff Augmentation)

Note : Need to support PST timings


Project Summary:

We are seeking highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineers to act as augmented members of a client's data team. You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of a complex, end-to-end data platform migration to Snowflake.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will be expected to integrate seamlessly with the existing team and take direct ownership of critical migration and data modelling tasks to accelerate the project's delivery. This is a complex transformation, not a simple "lift-and-shift."


Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Architecture:
  • Collaborate with the client's BI and Data Science teams to define data requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (e.g., Dimensional, Star Schema) optimized for Snowflake.
  • Develop and document data models, data definitions, and data flow diagrams for the new environment.
  • Data Migration & Engineering:
  • Execute the hands-on technical migration of data from legacy systems to the Snowflake Data Cloud
  • Engineer, build, and optimize robust ELT/ETL data pipelines within Snowflake (using SnowSQL, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, etc.).
  • Implement and automate data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
  • Team Integration & Delivery:
  • Integrate directly with the client's data team, participating in all relevant project routines and workflows.
  • Take ownership of assigned migration and modeling tasks, delivering high-quality, production-ready code and models with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to data migration, modeling, and pipeline performance.
  • Create clear technical documentation for all developed assets (models, pipelines, etc.).


Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Expert-level Snowflake: Deep, proven, hands-on experience with the Snowflake platform (architecture, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, performance optimization).
  • Expert-level Data Modeling: 4+ years of dedicated experience in data modeling (Dimensional, Relational) and data warehousing architecture.
  • Proven Data Migration: 4+ years of experience executing complex, large-scale data warehouse migrations (non-lift-and-shift).
  • Strong Data Engineering: Proficiency in building data pipelines (ELT/ETL) using SQL and modern tools (e.g., dbt, Python, or similar).
  • Execution Focus: A proven "do-er" with the ability to integrate into an existing team and deliver on complex technical tasks independently.
  • BI / Analytics Acumen: Strong understanding of how data models are consumed by BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) and Data Science workloads.
