title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes  Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

Inovação e tecnologia são forças que movem o Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

Estamos em busca de um talento analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento fullstack de uma nova plataforma de gestão industrial, um projeto estratégico que conectará dados, inteligência artificial e eficiência operacional.

Essa solução será a base para modelos preditivos de detecção de anomalias, permitindo a otimização proativa dos processos fabris e a melhoria contínua da performance industrial.

  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e no desenvolvimento de APIs REST.
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS e GCP), incluindo o uso de serviços serverless (AWS Lambda).

title: Profissional Back End – Java SR
description:
Código da vaga: 53781


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera back end, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Domínio em linguagens e frameworks Java SE e Java EE.
  • Vivência comprovada com Java 8 ou superior, incluindo uso de Lambdas, Streams e API de datas.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Spring Framework, incluindo Spring Boot e Spring MVC.
  • Experiência na construção de APIs RESTful e desenvolvimento de serviços web.
  • Conhecimento em microsserviços e arquitetura de software, incluindo padrões de comunicação (REST, Mensageria, Event-Driven).
  • Atuação prévia em processos de migração de sistemas monolíticos para arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados PostgreSQL e DB2, contemplando modelagem de dados, desenvolvimento de SQL avançado e otimização de consultas.
  • Familiaridade com servidores de aplicação, como JBoss e WebSphere.
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de ambientes Linux e elaboração de scripts para automação.
  • Experiência com Maven, Nexus e SonarQube para gerenciamento de builds, repositórios e qualidade de código.
  • Prática no uso do GitHub e implementação de pipelines de CI/CD, preferencialmente com GitHub Actions.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de testes automatizados utilizando JUnit e Mockito.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Application Support Specialist
description:
AppXite is a product software development company, based in Riga, Latvia. Our Platform is an AI-Ready Digital Marketplace, CPQ & Billing Platform for Telco, SaaS, Cloud, and AI services. It enables partners to build and monetize as-a-service offerings with flexible pricing models. The platform includes pre-built vendor and catalog integrations with major providers like Microsoft, Google, AWS, Adobe, and VMware. It supports various billing configurations, helping partners effectively manage and grow their businesses.

About the role:   

We are seeking a dedicated Support Specialist for our largest global customers. You will undergo initial training in our platform, but should already possess qualifications necessary for the role. We’re looking for someone to grow with us in a remote position, working North America hours on a long-term B2B basis.

Your mission:   

  • Technical support and troubleshooting.  
  • Operational support tasks in the Application Support team working with Microsoft Cloud technologies .  
  • Scope a customer issue by collecting the relevant facts and investigating the problem by doing his own research and by involving other teams as needed.  
  • Consult and collaborate with peers or colleagues around the world and with management and engineering to resolve service issues.  
  • Act internally as a customer/reseller advocate.  
  • Empower customers/resellers to find information, self-solve when they decide to, and learn more about Microsoft products, services, and support.  
  • Advise customers on how to gain additional value from their Microsoft products.  
  • Document technical work and research to help your colleagues to improve the product, and improve the support experience.  
  • Maintain a proactive approach to customer happiness, identifying customer satisfaction concerns and managing customer expectations.  
  • Having ownership of tasks, proactively following upon them, and ensuring fast resolution.  

That's you:   

  • Previous Support experience in IT.  
  • Strong SQL skills: ability to connect the database, ability to execute and create SQL queries.  
  • Hands-on experience working with APIs .  
  • Fluent English (verbal and written).  
  • Experience with Microsoft Cloud technologies (Azure) is a plus.  
  • Experience with troubleshooting SaaS application is a plus.  
  • Experience with licensing and invoices is a plus.  
  • Experience with MS partner center or similar administrator portals is a plus.  
  • Ability to identify, update and create Help Center articles to assist team members and external users with navigating and using a product.  
  • Ability to work as part of a team.  
  • Ability to make quick decisions, align priorities and execute tasks.  
  • Be able to stay calm under pressure.  
  • Ability to communicate well and precisely.  


Why join AppXite:

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role, or choose to work from our Latvia office.
  • Work With Global Tech Leaders: Collaborate on solutions used by some of the biggest names in the industry, including Adobe, AWS, Cisco, Google, IBM, Microsoft, Lenovo, and Liquid. Your work will help shape how these companies deliver services across the globe.
  • Skilled, International Team: Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We value technical excellence, clear communication, and mutual support.
  • Professional Development: Advance your skills with access to Microsoft certifications and continuous learning opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy four weeks of paid vacation per year, plus paid public holidays.
  • Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team - our employee referral program recognizes and rewards your contributions.


Join AppXite Platform Engineering team and work with a talented group of engineers building out next-generation technologies!

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview

  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!

  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks

*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Assegurar conformidade com acordos de licenciamento SAP, otimizando o uso de licenças e evitando custos desnecessários.

O que você precisa ter

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities

Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

description:
NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.

Responsabilidades:

  • Ser responsável técnico pelas metodologias de provisionamento de perda esperada (ECL) da carteira de crédito, assegurando consistência entre o modelo, as bases de dados e as regras contábeis.
  • Estruturar e automatizar pipelines de cálculo de PD, LGD e EAD em ambiente Databricks (PySpark/SQL), integrando os modelos às bases de produção e garantindo rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Conduzir análises retroativas e de performance dos modelos (backtesting, estabilidade de variáveis, KS, AUC, PSI, curing rate, hazard e survival curves) para identificar desvios e propor evoluções metodológicas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Contabilidade, Financeiro e Risco, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em soluções analíticas robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Acompanhar práticas de mercado e evoluções regulatórias, propondo inovações que aumentem a eficiência do provisionamento e a precisão das estimativas de risco.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em modelagem de risco de crédito regulatória (PD, LGD, EAD e Estágios IFRS9).
  • Domínio técnico das normas IFRS9 e regulamentos BACEN (4966, 229, 2682).
  • Proficiência em Python (pandas, pyspark, scikit-learn) e SQL, com foco em manipulação e modelagem de grandes bases de dados.
  • Vivência com Databricks e Spark, preferencialmente em ambientes de produção (Delta Tables, workflows automatizados).
  • Sólida experiência em avaliação de performance de modelos (KS, AUC, PSI, estabilidade).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento, governança e documentação de modelos (MLflow, Git, Confluence).


Desejável

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, bancos digitais ou consultorias de risco regulatório.
  • Conhecimento prático de provisão contábil, roll rates, vintage analysis e estrutura de matrizes de transição.
  • Noções de LGD baseada em recuperação e fluxos de castigo (cash flow de perda).


O que você vai encontrar por aqui?

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.


Conhece alguma pessoa aqui na Natura?

Se sim, peça o e-mail corporativo dessa pessoa e, ao se inscrever para uma vaga, utilize-o para solicitar uma recomendação. É uma excelente oportunidade para fortalecer sua rede de contatos e avançar no seu processo seletivo em nossa empresa!

A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

Convidamos #Mulheres, #PessoasNegras, #PessoasComDeficiência, pessoas da comunidade #LGBTQIA+, #Gestantes e pessoas com #50anos+ a se candidatarem para esta vaga!

description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.

title: Clinical Site Manager
description:
Clinical Site Manager – (Ophthalmology & Neurology Focus)

Location: Remote-based


We’re partnering with a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing treatments in Ophthalmology, Neurology , and other complex therapeutic areas. To support several ongoing and upcoming studies, we are seeking a Clinical Site Manager to oversee key investigator sites across LATAM .

This position is offering a unique opportunity to blend operational oversight with strong relationship management at the site level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary sponsor contact for assigned sites and CRO monitors, ensuring high-quality communication and collaboration.

  • Therapeutic experience in Ophthalmology and/or Neurology is essential.
  • Additional experience in Immunology, Rare Diseases, or Respiratory indications would be advantageous.
  • Solid understanding of GCP , ICH Guidelines , and regional regulatory requirements across Eastern Europe.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel across assigned countries as required.


Why Join?

  • Play a pivotal role in advancing innovative treatments that make a meaningful difference to patients’ lives.
  • Work in a hands-on, strategic role bridging sponsor oversight and site engagement.
  • Join an international, science-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.



About Planet Pharma:


Planet Pharma is an American parented Employment Business/Agency that provides global staffing services with its head-quarters in Chicago and our EMEA regional office located in Central London. We have invested significantly in creating a robust international platform that enables us to work compliantly in 30+ countries with a current network of 2500+ active contractors globally as well as a very strong permanent / direct hire recruitment offering.


Our specialist knowledge and close relationships with our clients and the wider industry really makes us unique in our field. Just recently we were recognised by FORBES as the 17th best professional staffing firm, and have won multiple awards from industry accredited bodies for our commitment to excellence and service delivery. We have extensive functional expertise including: Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, QA, QC, Submissions experts, Clinical development, Quality, Biostatistics, and Medical Affairs / Writing.

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance .   • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.

title: Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby on Rails
description:

Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Ruby on Rails em ambiente de produção.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de sistemas web escaláveis, considerando boas práticas de design, organização de código e manutenção de projetos de longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados relacionais e otimização de queries SQL, especialmente em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.

  • Experiência com performance tuning e estratégias para alta escalabilidade.

Infraestrutura e DevOps:

  • Experiência com Docker para containerização de aplicações.
  • Vivência em AWS com serviços como ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ElasticSearch e Redis.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade:

  • Capacidade de configurar e interpretar métricas de APM e erros.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como New Relic, Datadog, Sentry ou similares.


Integrações e Comunicação entre Sistemas:

  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Sidekiq ou similares).
  • Boas práticas em comunicação entre sistemas distribuídos (eventos assíncronos, retries, idempotência).
  • Experiência em background jobs, com foco em throughput, concorrência e resiliência.


Performance e Boas Práticas:

  • Experiência em otimização de aplicações web (tempo de resposta, uso de cache, indexação de banco).
  • Domínio em boas práticas de programação (Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de aplicações web (OWASP Top 10, autenticação, criptografia).


Desejável :

  • Experiência em integração com gateways de pagamento (ex: Stripe, Adyen, Pagar.me, Cielo, Stone, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação e segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, assinatura de mensagens).
  • Vivência com conciliação de transações financeiras e tratamento de falhas em fluxos críticos (reprocessamento seguro, antifraude, consistência de dados).


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the role:


As a Senior Cloud Native Developer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, cloud-native applications using Azure and .NET technologies . You will collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality software solutions that follow modern engineering practices.

This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Azure cloud services , microservices , and backend development , combined with strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications using Azure services , .NET Core , and C# .
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to ensure smooth and automated deployments.
  • Define and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Pulumi .
  • Develop microservices and event-driven architectures leveraging Azure Functions , Azure Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs , ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, QA, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply best practices for monitoring , logging , and application performance management .
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience in software development with .NET Core and C# .
  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services , including Azure Functions , Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with Application Insights , Grafana , or other monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of MuleSoft or similar integration platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.

  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!
